newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: New Congo aims to boost gold production.
newsitem.headline: New Congo aims to boost gold production.

text.p: The Democratic Republic of Congo hopes to sharply increase production of gold, Mines Minister Florent Mututulo said.
The new Congo government wanted the country to become one of the top gold producers in the world, Mututulo told a sub-Saharan Oil and Minerals conference on Tuesday night.
Societe Miniere et Industrielle du Kivu (Sominki) had the potential to become a major producer of the metal, he said.
Mututulo said it was a priority for the new government to increase output of gold in a mining sector regarded by the former government as its private domain.
